title: Exercise post-restart announce send end-to-end in persistence tests
description: P3 (wave-4 review of worker6-d4wr): the two failure-injection tests in python/tests/test_node.py (~:2470/2520) restart the node and verify build_announce + receiver processing but never invoke the restarted node's _send_announce(), so the post-restart reserve -> write -> advance-at-healed-revision path is not executed end-to-end (the anchor contract is only exercised inside _load_locked). Fix: extend both tests to drive one real send after restart and assert sequence/tx outcomes.
